Namecheap is great as a cheap registrar and for tiny sites.

Once shared hosting starts throttling you (slow pages, `508 Resource Limit Is Reached` errors, no root, no managed database), move up to managed cloud. Kloudbean runs your app on your own server across seven clouds, with managed databases, Git deploy, staging, and automatic backups, from $8/mo. Keep your domain at Namecheap and just point DNS.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/namecheap-alternative/
